answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 25 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The walnut register is checked at draw time, beacon lists the eligible set, and cipher seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 25 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 26 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
